messages:
sara kim: Quick note 69: midyear review process kicks off next Tue. Self-assessments open 2026-06-08 and close 2026-06-15 EOD. Managers: please prepare summaries by 2026-06-20. Calibration week is 2026-06-22. Link to guide + form: <https://redwood-internal/forms/midyear-2026|midyear guide>.
tom reed: thanks! will managers get calendar invites or do we pick slots?
sara kim: HR will auto-send 60min calibration invites to managers tomorrow AM. If you need a swap, DM me and well reassign.
anya petrov: what level of evidence in manager summaries? short bullets or mini narratives?
sara kim: bullets + 1-2 signal examples (metrics or customer impact) is ideal. Avoid long narratives.
lucy chen: do ICs need to ask peers for feedback or does HR collect skip-levels centrally?
sara kim: peers/skip-levels are coordinated by managers. If you want anonymous peer feedback, ask your manager to request it via the form.
hr-bot: Copyable checklist:
- IC: start self-assessment between 2026-06-08 and 2026-06-15
- Manager: draft summary by 2026-06-20
- Manager: attend assigned 60min calibration slot during week of 2026-06-22
- HR: publish provisional calibrations by 2026-06-24
- Appeals window (provisional): 2026-06-25 to 2026-06-28

sara kim: small note on timing: if someone is on extended leave, flag me and well extend their individual deadline. Keep manager summaries internal and confidential until HR posts calibration notes.
tom reed: can I pull a CSV of completion states for my team?
sara kim: yes: `hrctl reviews export --team tom --fields name,email,status` returns a CSV.
anya petrov: thanks! will remind my team to use the template in the form.
sara kim: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
